Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod. I replied in your thread there with the same answer.

He first posted 300, then corrected it a few minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active seats on the production roster as of Jul 1. Ruth also acknowledged 280 in the channel.

That count is from July, so check it against the current roster if you need today's number.
